sources.note: THE INSTRUCTION SAYS IT OUTRIGHT: the 1099s are INSIDE the client's gross receipts, not beside them. Summing the record and the forms states income the business never took. `sum_parts` where there is no record at all, because a business with 1099s and no sheet still has that income and holding it would report nothing rather than something incomplete — the 1099s are a floor, and the sheet is what a preparer is asked for.

Expenses for business use of your home. Do not report these expenses elsewhere. Attach Form 8829 unless using the simplified method. See instructions. Simplified method filers only: Enter the total square footage of (a) your home: and (b) the part of your home used for business: . Use the Simplified Method Worksheet in the instructions to figure the amount to enter on line 30

Net profit or (loss). Subtract line 30 from line 29. • If a profit, enter on both Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 3, and on Schedule SE, line 2. (If you checked the box on line 1, see instructions.) Estates and trusts, enter on Form 1041, line 3. • If a loss, you must go to line 32.

If you have a loss, check the box that describes your investment in this activity. See instructions. • If you checked 32a, enter the loss on both Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 3, and on Schedule SE, line 2. (If you checked the box on line 1, see the line 31 instructions.) Estates and trusts, enter on Form 1041, line 3. • If you checked 32b, you must attach Form 6198. Your loss may be limited.
